23. PDISCONNECT HEATED OXYGEN SENSOR FROM
FRONT EXHAUST PIPE
Remove the 2 nuts, and disconnect oxygen sensor and gasket.
24. REMOVE EXHAUST PIPE ASSEMBLY
(a) Remove the 2 bolts and nuts holding the front exhaust
pipe to the No.2 front exhaust pipe.
(b) Remove the 2 bolts and pipe support bracket.
(c) Remove the gasket, and disconnect the front exhaust
pipe.

(d) Disconnect the hook of the tailpipe from the 2 rings.
(e) Disconnect the 2 rings on the exhaust pipe from the ex-
haust pipe brackets, and remove the exhaust pipe as-
sembly.

25. REMOVE NO.2 FRONT EXHAUST PIPE
Remove the 3 nuts, front exhaust pipe and gasket.

26. REMOVE EXHAUST PIPE HEAT INSULATOR
Remove the 4 nuts and heat insulator.
27. REMOVE REAR CENTER FLOOR CROSSMEMBER
BRACE
Remove the 4 bolts (Normal roof) or 6 bolts (Sport roof) and
crossmember brace.
28. REMOVE PROPELLER SHAFT
(See page PR-4 )
